source_assertions.name: item_attributes_service_account_only
source_assertions.meaning: the lookup key is exactly service + account

source_assertions.name: value_is_raw_passphrase_bytes
source_assertions.meaning: kSecValueData is the passphrase bytes with no go-keyring prefix or encoding

source_assertions.name: store_deletes_before_add
source_assertions.meaning: Save first deletes any existing item, then adds

source_assertions.name: store_duplicate_updates_in_place
source_assertions.meaning: errSecDuplicateItem after the add falls back to an in-place update

source_assertions.name: update_replaces_value_data_only
source_assertions.meaning: the in-place update changes kSecValueData and nothing else

source_assertions.name: update_scoped_to_default_keychain
source_assertions.meaning: the update matches only the default keychain (kSecMatchSearchList)

source_assertions.name: load_checks_item_before_prompt
source_assertions.meaning: Load verifies the item exists (no data returned) BEFORE showing the biometric prompt

source_assertions.name: load_missing_item_is_not_configured
source_assertions.meaning: errSecItemNotFound becomes ErrBiometricNotConfigured, not a keychain error

source_assertions.name: load_prompt_timeout_30s
source_assertions.meaning: the biometric prompt gives up after 30 seconds

source_assertions.name: load_prompt_failure_is_auth_failed
source_assertions.meaning: an unavailable policy, timeout or rejection all return errSecAuthFailed

source_assertions.name: passphrase_is_c_string
source_assertions.meaning: save and load go through NUL-terminated C strings, so a passphrase is cut at its first NUL byte

source_assertions.name: save_requires_availability
source_assertions.meaning: Save refuses without biometric hardware before touching the keychain
